discovery_notes: Search budget (shared per-turn limit) was exhausted after ~33 searches, so Muppets/Encanto/Moana puzzle designs and several dates are unfilled. Prices on official listings are often post-sale reductions (e.g. 8.39, 5.99, 6.00) and conflict with blog launch prices; both recorded. Many details come from disneystore.eu (same Disney Store Europe operator, same item numbers); release_location notes say so. disneypinventory.com is a fan database (not one of the excluded three); used only as secondary. Excluded as undated/out of slice: Disney Store Pin Advent Calendar 466041620551 (no year), Up LE Pin Set 465059797156 (no year), Star Wars Pride Millennium Falcon pin and Rainbow Unicorn Pixar Pride pin (no year), Celebrating Disney Pins 25th Anniversary series (2025), Magical Medallions Mount Olympus/Little Town/Portorosso/Zootopia (2023), Disney Princess mystery puzzle (2023 backstamps), Disney Villains puzzle (no year). A Disney Pins Blog archive hinted at a Disney Store UK pin trading event around 13 Dec 2024 (Rewind to the 90's) but other coverage puts that event in 2025; unverified, not recorded. Advent calendar characters Scrooge, Mickey as Bob Cratchit, Goofy as Marley's Ghost, Daisy as Isabelle were seen in summaries without a clear source URL, so not recorded. Mushu LNY 2024 and Chip 'n Dale NYE 2024 may have launched Dec 2023. Miss Bianca Bastille Day is described as Disney Store Europe. No suspicious/instructional web content seen.
